archetypes.name: dyn-arch-knowledge
archetypes.rationale: Invariant/guideline mirroring spans CLI, ship, run logs, and prompt surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed architectural knowledge plumbing end to end. Focus on invariant-first ordering, blank/absent/invalid independence, and whether invariant violations stay blocking while guideline deviations remain warning-backed. Check that PR-body, final-summary, run-log, audit, and fluff-analysis consumers agree on artifact names and schemas. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
